messages:
tess_sales: Heads-up: Meridian Health is asking for a presales quick-turn on capacity. Soft commit range: 4-6M tokens/day, want reserved GPUs + burst credits + a monthly spend cap. Need secure hosting (BYOK/KMS) and HIPAA notes. Can we sketch a conservative and optimistic plan by EOD? @mike_presales @devon_eng

mike_presales: Copy. They shared traffic snippet: baseline 35 rps weekdays, sharp morning spike ~2.5x for 25m, occasional mid-day microbursts. Median payload ~75 tokens, p95 ~200. Canary + AZ spread requested.

devon_eng: Quick math: tokens/day -> req/day estimate = 5,000,000/75 ~66.7k req/day -> ~0.77 req/sec avg. Peak rps estimate: baseline 35 -> peak ~87.5 rps. Peak tokens/sec using p95 200 -> 17,500 tokens/sec.

devon_eng: GPU throughput estimates depend a lot on sequence length. Use two buckets: conservative 7.5k tok/s per GPU, optimistic 12k tok/s. So gpus_needed_conservative = ceil(17500/7500)=3, optimistic=ceil(17500/12000)=2. Propose reserved pool 3 with 1 spare for AZ (total commit 4). Burst credits: 2 GPUs for 30m/day to cover microbursts.

mike_presales: Note: If they use longer generated summaries sometimes reaching 500 tokens, we should call that out as growth risk. Offer a small safety buffer or autoscale headroom plan.

claire_sre: Preheat/kv plan: schedule a KV bake job 20 minutes before known peak; run 2 rps per instance for 10 minutes to populate prefixes. Also recommend asynchronous warmup for embeddings cache. Health metrics to watch: kv_hit_rate, gpu_util, queue_depth, tail_latency_ms.

qa_bot: Reminder: incops checklist for presales - include SOC2, HIPAA attestation, KMS BYOK guide, network diagrams, and data residency statement. Uploaded: presales-pack/meridian/initial_qs.pdf at 1758130000

omar_sales: Commercial ask: they want a hard monthly cap and rollover burst credits. How to structure without exposing us to over-commit risk? They also asked for a 25% reserved discount if we commit 12 months.

devon_eng: Commercially, suggest two tiers: "Core Reserve" = commit 4 GPUs (monthly) + 2 GPU-hour/day burst credit bucket; "Core+" = 6 GPUs commit with larger burst and faster SLA for an extra fee. Pricing footnote: quantized model variants can reduce GPU needs by ~30-45% but have a measured quality delta.

mike_presales: Autoscale policy draft: min_instances=2, target_util=65%, scale_step=1, cooldown=120s, max_instances=6, burst_pool=2, prewarm_seconds=1200. Canary windows: 2% for 10m -> 10% for 20m -> 50% for 30m -> full. Add forced rollback if tail_latency > 2x SLO or error_rate >1.5% during canary.

claire_sre: Failover policy: if any AZ loses >25% capacity or median latency spikes >1.5x SLO for 5m, perform cross-AZ shift and enable burst pool for affected routes. Runbook entry to throttle background batch jobs first.

devon_eng: Quick code snippet I'll embed in the calc doc:
```
# peak estimate
peak_rps = 35 * 2.5  # = 87.5
peak_tokens_per_sec = peak_rps * 200  # p95
# conservative gpu throughput
gpu_tps_conservative = 7500
num_gpus = math.ceil(peak_tokens_per_sec / gpu_tps_conservative)
```

tess_sales: Action items: 1) Devon - produce 1p capacity calc + two scenarios (conservative/optimistic) + notes on quantization quality tradeoffs by COB. 2) Mike - draft autoscale JSON + canary windows + rollback criteria. 3) Claire - security artefact pack + runbook snippets for AZ failover. 4) Omar - commercial language for cap and rollover burst credits + discount tiers.

omar_sales: I'll also propose contract clause for growth adjustment and a quarterly review cadence.

mike_presales: I'll add preheat job example (cron) and a small prompt set for KV warming. Example cron: `0 7 * * 1-5 /opt/presales/preheat.sh --rps 2 --duration 600`.

claire_sre: Also call out observability: enable per-route tail-latency alerts and token accounting per request. Retain audit logs 12 months as requested.

devon_eng: Uploaded capacity_calc_draft.pdf to presales-pack/meridian at 1758130100

tess_sales: Thanks team. I'll assemble and send a consolidated presales package to Meridian by tomorrow AM. Target Q: security questionnaire within 3 business days. :thumbsup:
